subject: Debugging
arc_note: C3.2-heavy debugging subject. Every sheet debugs code that INVOLVES A LOOP (repeating events) so C1 reaches G3. Mix of block + Turtle contexts (students have done both). Method on every sheet: say what it SHOULD do → spot the wrong/missing/extra part → fix it. Each buggy case AND its fix are modelled in solution.py and asserted. C1-L4: the fix is writing corrected code (write) + the bug-find is altering/describing (alter).

topics.title: What Is a Bug?
topics.concept: debugging method + find a wrong repeat count in a loop (block)

topics.title: Off by One
topics.concept: the repeat/range count is one too many or too few (block + turtle)

topics.title: The Wrong Block Inside
topics.concept: a wrong action inside the loop (e.g. move vs turn) (block)

topics.title: The Wrong Turn
topics.concept: wrong angle in a turtle shape loop — shape doesn't close (turtle)

topics.title: Extra or Missing Block
topics.concept: loop has an extra block or is missing a needed one (block)

topics.title: Trace the Bug
topics.concept: predict what the buggy loop does, then say the fix (read/predict)

topics.title: More Than One Fix
topics.concept: a loop bug with two valid fixes — choose and justify (challenge)
